name: Kuda uhodjat mamy?
source:
Rumors say: if you find an unused tunnel in the city's subway at Sayran station, walk through it entirely, and manage to catch a passing train, any dearest wish of yours will come true.

Four mothers failed to protect their children. They descend into the tunnel with a single request – to bring them back to life.
